summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Brown Advisory Sustainable Growth ETF (BASG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund seeks capital appreciation by actively managing a narrow portfolio of US mid- and large-cap growth companies. Selected securities are believed to not only demonstrate strong fundamentals but also implement sustainability strategies. BASG was launched on Jun 13, 2025 and is issued by Brown Advisory.

holdings.infoBox: BASG is an equity ETF with a total of 35 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 8.52%, Microsoft at 6.01%, Amazon.com at 5.85%, Visa Inc. at 4.82%, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 4.82%.
